regulations.notes: Counts toward the 50 panfish daily limit (listed as spotted sunfish, 'stumpknocker'); no length limit. Freshwater game fish: may not be sold.

economy.notes: Florida game fish cannot be sold.

facts: In Howard T. Odum's classic 1957 study of Silver Springs, the spotted sunfish was the most abundant sunfish.
'Stumpknocker' comes from its habit of picking insects off submerged logs.
It tolerates more salt than other sunfish, so it lives in coastal streams where salt water pushes in.

research.task: Catch one on a cricket beside a stump or cypress knee
Catch one in the Spring Run

ledger.wrenNote: Stumpknockers sit right up against the wood. Little hook, little cricket, flip it into the shade of the knee. Nothing in ten seconds? Move to the next stump.
